subject: ACME - Invoice estimate & cost model
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T15:10:00Z
Subject: Post-call: token volumes and next steps (cost model attached)

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery call:

What we heard
- Primary use: customer support assistant + context-aware search (mixed chat + embedding workloads)
- Peak TPS: ~120 requests/minute, average session length ~450 tokens output, ~150 tokens input
- Expected monthly volume range (conservative -> aggressive): 200M -> 1.2B tokens/month
- Target procurement window: Dec 2026 (FY27 budget)

Requested by ACME
- A clear invoice estimate tied to 3 volume bands (200M, 600M, 1.2B)
- Unit economics expressed as $ per 1M tokens and expected monthly spend
- Any recommended optimizations to hit a target cost of ~$1,200 per 1M tokens (target shared on call)

Attached: ACME_token_cost_model_v3.xlsx (cost model + sample invoice rows) and a short Redwood pricing estimate PDF.

High-level notes on the model
- Base model assumes hosted inference on medium-latency profile with batching and KV caching enabled.
- We factor in 10% cache hit rate for repeated prompts (can be improved with prompt engineering/edge caching).
- Quantization profile: int8 inference where available; we show delta vs fp16.

Next steps
1) I attached a spreadsheet with three bands — please confirm which band you want us to quote formally.
2) If Finance wants a formal invoice template, loop in acct-payable@acme-corp.com and we’ll generate it.
3) Jordan (cc) can run a short POC to validate latency at your 450-token output profile — want to schedule next week?

If you want, I can also produce a simple 1-page invoice estimate with line items (model cost, data egress, support).

Thanks —
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme-corp.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@acme-corp.com>
Date: 2026-11-26T10:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call: token volumes and next steps (cost model attached)

Thanks Sean — this is helpful. A few clarifying points from our side:

- The 1.2B/month number is our internal upside; realistic procurement ask is likely the 600M band for the first 6 months.
- Can you show the $/1M tokens both with and without reserved (committed) capacity? Our procurement team prefers committed pricing if the delta is >10%.
- We also need an expected monthly invoice line for support (SLA) and we want a simple forecast for months 1-6 assuming 20% MoM growth.

Also looped in Tom (Finance) — he may have follow-up on PO/payment terms.

Priya Shah
Head of Product (AI), Acme Corp
priya.shah@acme-corp.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme-corp.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-27T09:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call: token volumes and next steps (cost model attached)

Thanks Priya — good direction. Quick answers inline and updated ask for Finance: 

- Reserved vs on-demand: attached spreadsheet has two tabs (on_demand vs committed_12mo). At the 600M band committed 12mo yields ~14% reduction vs on-demand assuming steady state.
- Unit economics: we included a column for $/1M tokens (net) and one for gross cost before support/egress. For 600M band the model shows: 
  - On-demand: $1,560 / 1M tokens
  - Committed: $1,340 / 1M tokens
  - With additional optimizations (higher caching, batching): effective $1,200 / 1M tokens achievable
- Support/SLA: we break out a standard 24x7 enterprise support line at $3,000/mo and a premium SLA at $12,000/mo (optional).

Tom — can you confirm your preferred payment terms (Net30 vs Net60) and whether you need Redwood to issue an invoice or a pro forma first? If you prefer, Monica can prep the invoice estimate.

Jordan — can you run the latency POC for the 450-token output + 120 TPS profile? Priya suggested next Wed/Thu — please propose a window.

Best,
Sean

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme-corp.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@acme-corp.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-28T14:40:00Z
Subject: ACME invoice estimate (attached)

Priya / Tom —

Attached is a one-page invoice estimate (redwood-pricing-estimate.pdf) and an updated cost breakdown Excel (ACME_token_cost_model_v3.xlsx) that includes a month-by-month forecast assuming 20% MoM growth for the first 6 months. Highlights:

- 600M band (commissioning month + growth): estimated month 1 spend: $780k, month 6 spend: $1.9M; 6-month total: $7.2M.
- Effective committed unit price in the model: $1,340 / 1M tokens (12mo commit).
- To achieve the target $1,200 / 1M tokens we recommend: 1) 12mo commit at 1.2B band or 2) enable further caching + opt-in quantization on specific model routes.
- Line items: model inference, KV cache storage, data egress, support, and enterprise features (tracing/retention).

Action items for Finance
- If PO required, please send ACME_PO_1126.pdf (attached) and confirm Net30 vs Net60.
- If you want a formal signed SOW to lock committed discounts, we can route through Legal.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@acme-corp.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, acct-payable@acme-corp.com
Date: 2026-11-29T12:05:00Z
Subject: Re: ACME invoice estimate (attached)

Monica — thanks for the detailed breakdown. A couple of finance items:

- We attached a PO (ACME_PO_1126.pdf) and prefer Net30. Please confirm Redwood can invoice monthly.
- For the committed discount we will need a short SOW or contract appendix that defines the 12mo commit and the 1.2B threshold. Can Legal draft a short appendix?
- Please also include a sample invoice showing line items and tax treatment (we’re in California).

I’ll wait for the formal invoice and SOW appendix.

Thanks —
Tom Ellis
Head of Finance, Acme Corp
acct-payable@acme-corp.com
